01 INTERVIEW SESSION

Record a podcast in Limassol.

An interview goes better when the host can listen. Bring your questions and your guest. For a technician-led recording, we’ll take care of the mic levels and choose the camera angle as the conversation moves.

01 SESSION NOTES

One wide shot. A close-up on each speaker.

01

Before you sit down

Send the show name and let us know who’s taking part. A two-person conversation suits the lounge layout. If you have a third speaker, we’ll plan the seating and framing around all three microphones.

02

What you take home

The proposed €95 assisted hour includes the live-switched HD video and an audio copy of the mixed programme. If you want repeated takes removed or your intro added afterwards, choose the edited episode.

03

Bringing your own editor

Tell us which files your editor needs before the shoot. Individual camera recordings need a separate capture and transfer plan. Our standard session delivers the switched recording.

02 BEFORE YOU RECORD

Good questions.

Which languages can we record an interview in?

You can record your interview in English, Greek or Russian. If you need captions in another language, tell us before filming so we can agree the edit.

Can I hire the podcast studio without a technician?

The proposed self-service hour is €55 for returning users who have completed an induction. If this is your first recording, start with the technician-led session.

Can we keep the same set for our next episode?

Yes. We can keep a reference for the chairs, lighting, camera positions and show graphic so the next conversation has a consistent look.
